candidate.claim: prevIndex is tested for truthiness, so when the first slash is at index 0 (leading-slash input like "/foo") prevIndex becomes 0 and is treated as falsy. The final tokens update is skipped, leaving the last token value as '' and maxDepth under-counted.
candidate.title: Falsy zero check skips last token update for leading slash

verifier.reason: At scan.js:382 prevIndex is set to the slash index i, so for "/foo" it becomes 0, and the guard at scan.js:390 tests prevIndex for truthiness, causing the last-token assignment and depth accounting at scan.js:391-393 to be skipped.
